import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.scatterplot(x='megapixels', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', 
                size='weight_grams', alpha=0.6, data=df.sample(frac=1, random_state=42))
plt.xscale('log')
plt.yscale('log')
plt.xlabel('Megapixels (log scale)')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD, log scale)')
plt.title('Camera Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type\n(PointSize = Weight in Grams)')
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd

import seaborn as sns

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.scatterplot(x='megapixels', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', 
                size='weight_grams', alpha=0.6, data=df.sample(frac=1, random_state=42))
plt.xscale('log')
plt.yscale('log')
plt.xlabel('Megapixels (log scale)')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD, log scale)')
plt.title('Camera Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type\n(PointSize = Weight in Grams)')
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
